Talyvor Docs is installed as {{ include "docs.fullname" . }} in {{ .Release.Namespace }}.

It reads its secrets from the Secret "{{ include "docs.secretName" . }}"
(DOCS_DATABASE_URL and GATEWAY_AUTH_SECRET are required).

Check it answers:
  kubectl -n {{ .Release.Namespace }} port-forward svc/{{ include "docs.fullname" . }} {{ .Values.service.port }}
  curl http://localhost:{{ .Values.service.port }}/healthz

Every /v1 request must arrive through the edge gateway with x-gateway-auth;
/healthz and /readyz answer without it.
